bagPolicy.summary: Bags no bigger than 40cm x 40cm x 20cm are allowed. Large rucksacks, luggage, or oversized bags are not permitted.
allowed: Bags no bigger than 40cm x 40cm x 20cm
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is limited car parking available in The Point Village carpark, which is not operated by 3Arena. Due to potential traffic congestion on show nights, public transport is recommended.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in 3Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Bars and retail units throughout 3Arena serve alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks plus confectionery and snacks. Outside food and drinks are not permitted, and the venue says it does not have sit-down food areas.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible tickets should be booked in advance through Ticketmaster. Guests with mobility needs are directed to the accessible area, flat seating, or lower-tier Blocks A–G; wheelchairs are not permitted on the ground floor. Contact enquiry@3arena.ie or 01 866 3400 for special-access questions.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted. Guests who leave during a show will not be readmitted.

ticketPickup.title: Ticket Collection
ticketPickup.body: Collect tickets at the box office at the front of the building on the Liffey side. It opens at 6:30 p.m. on show nights.

gates.title: Entrances & Doors
gates.body: Use the entrance shown in event communications and follow on-site signage. The box-office entrance is at the front of the building on the Liffey side; public door times vary by show.
